category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The exact product is positioned for fine-hair volume and 2-in-1 care, not a named scalp concern; the ordinary balanced route is supported.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Moderate: SLES leads the formula, but CAPB, coco-glucoside and 2-in-1 care routes buffer the net cleansing below strong. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: fine — Exact fine-hair volume positioning and no silicone stack support fine hair; moderate weight keeps the high-conditioning 2-in-1 architecture from becoming an automatic exclusion. Conditional (not emitted): normal — The 2-in-1 can suit normal hair needing care, but high conditioning makes it less clearly volume-preserving as a diameter-level default. coarse — High rinse-off conditioning is useful, but the volume/fine-hair positioning and lack of a richer coarse-hair care system make this situational.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES leads the formula, but CAPB, coco-glucoside and 2-in-1 care routes buffer the net cleansing below strong.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: High: explicit 2-in-1 positioning is backed by protein, panthenol, glyceryl oleate, cationic guar and lipid/fatty ester routes, making substantial rinse-off care likely.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete ordered formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Volume: the exact German product name and claims target lifeless/fine hair volume, and the silicone-free formula keeps that role compatible despite 2-in-1 care.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 2-in-1 care is not a distinct v1.4 focus value, and there is no separate gentle, shine, repair, clarifying or scalp-active claim with an independent route.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: dermatological/pH-neutral wording is present, but the product is positioned for volume and 2-in-1 care rather than sensitive, itchy or uncomfortable scalp.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are ordinary rinse-out use and no explicit daily, treatment, alternating, clarifying or reset trigger appears.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: 2-in-1 care routes can leave bounded residue, but silicone-free volume positioning and SLES/CAPB cleansing argue against high weight.
